audit_role: Senior Academic Regulation Researcher, RAG Safety Engineer, and Research Evaluation Auditor

course_level_grading_debarment.threshold: 70% minimum attendance in course lectures, tutorials, and practicals combined
course_level_grading_debarment.consequence: Award of 'X' grade and repetition of the course when next offered
course_level_grading_debarment.regulatory_nature: Course-level academic performance and evaluation standard

end_semester_examination_eligibility.threshold: 75% minimum aggregate attendance across all registered courses
end_semester_examination_eligibility.consequence: Debarment from End Semester Examination; withholding of Examination Admit Card
end_semester_examination_eligibility.enforcing_authority: Registrar / Academic Council / Controller of Examination (pursuant to UGC Regulations 2003)
end_semester_examination_eligibility.regulatory_nature: University-wide institutional statutory examination hall entry condition

medical_relaxation_condonation.conditions: Continuous illness of minimum two weeks with certified medical proof or authorized university deputation
medical_relaxation_condonation.regulatory_nature: Statutory condonation floor shared identically across 2017 and 2022 frameworks

AQ-01.query: What is the minimum attendance required?
AQ-01.condition: UNANCHORED_GENERAL_ATTENDANCE (Dual threshold: Exam eligibility vs Course grade)
AQ-01.evaluation: Legitimate ambiguity requiring disclosure of both 75% exam hall threshold and 70% course grade threshold.

AQ-02.query: What attendance is required to sit for end semester exams?
AQ-02.evaluation: False partial due to CECI 0.419 threshold; top hit 0280358a (Notification 307) provides direct, definitive 75% answer.

AQ-03.query: How much attendance is required to avoid an X grade?
AQ-03.evaluation: False conflict; both current SCSET 2022 and historical SEAS 2017 unanimously prescribe 70% threshold.

AQ-04.evaluation: Not a regulatory contradiction; 70% is sufficient for course grade/credit but insufficient for exam hall.

AQ-05.evaluation: CECI 0.325 dropped to insufficient because SCSET PDF omits literal '75%'. Cross-document inference confirms Notification 307 binds all schools.

AQ-06.query: What was the attendance rule in 2017?
AQ-06.evaluation: False conflict; query explicitly provides temporal anchor 'in 2017'. System should anchor to SEAS 2017 rather than flagging newer rules.

AQ-07.query: Can attendance be relaxed due to medical reasons?
AQ-07.evaluation: False conflict; both SEAS 2017 and SCSET 2022 contain identical 10% medical relaxation clauses. Flagged solely because one doc is marked is_current=False.

controller_gap_findings.name: False Conflict on Consensus Rules across Current and Historical Versions
controller_gap_findings.description: EvidenceController flags CONFLICTING whenever a current and historical document are co-retrieved, even when their clauses specify identical thresholds and conditions (e.g. 70% for X-grade in AQ-03, 10% medical condonation in AQ-07).

controller_gap_findings.name: Inability to Respect Explicit Temporal / Cohort Query Anchors
controller_gap_findings.description: When a query explicitly specifies a historical year or cohort ('What was the attendance rule in 2017?' in AQ-06), the pipeline retrieves the correct 2017 passage but EvidenceController still flags CONFLICTING against newer documents instead of scoping retrieval to the requested cohort.

controller_gap_findings.name: Collapse of Distinct Regulatory Conditions into Flat Numerical Contradictions
controller_gap_findings.description: The system treats 70% course grade debarment and 75% end-semester exam hall eligibility as an irreconcilable conflict rather than recognizing them as two distinct regulatory stages with separate enforcement authorities.

controller_improvement_recommendations.action: Introduce Consensus Verification prior to conflict triggering
controller_improvement_recommendations.summary: Check if extracted regulatory thresholds/consequences in retrieved historical and current passages match. If numerical values and conditions are identical, emit SUFFICIENT.
Extract year/cohort entities (e.g. '2017', 'first batch') and filter/boost matching historical documents while disabling newer superseding conflicts.
